tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rab gnas 'bring po'i cho ga 'khor lo bde mchog la sbyar ba byin rlabs rab 'byams bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī tsakra samba rā ya/ 'dir rab gnas 'bring po 'khor lo bde mchog la sbyar ba'i lugs kyi ngag 'don gang yin gtso bor brjod na/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga don gnyis lhun grub sor bzhag de la bde mchog gi khyad chos rnams bsgyur bar bya ste/ gnas yo byin brlabs nas bdag bskyed rdzogs pa'i cho ga gsum gyi bsrung ba'i bar dang / rnam rgyal dang las bum sgrub tshul dkyil chog bzhin/ bsang ba thams cad sumbha nis bya/ khrus bum brgyad sgrub pa'i skabs las sngags sumbha ni bzla/ drag po'i sbyang ba'i bden bdar gyi skabs su bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / zhes sbyar/ rten bskyed kyi skabs su/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong nor lha'i sku thams cad padma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhes pa nas sku can du gyur zhes pa'i bar bdag 'jug slob dpon gyi skabs bzhin/ dkyil 'khor yod na nang gi gtso 'khor thams cad kyang 'di bzhin bskyed/ chos po ti dang / gzungs dang yig 'bru rnams bdag 'jug gi 'od dpag med bzhin dang / mchod rten bdag 'jug gi rnam snang bzhin bskyed pa zhu ba las mchod rten du gyur pa'i nang padma nyi ma'i gdan lnga la rnam snang dbus bzhugs kyi rigs lnga bdag 'jug bzhin bskyed/ thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong gi sku rnams mi bskyed pa dang / gtsug lag khang / rnam snang bskyed zhu gtsug lag khang du gyur nang rigs lnga bskyed pa sogs mchod rten dang 'dra ba las mchod rten gyi khyad chos dor ba'i byang shar du chos skyong shar lhor nor lha bskyed pa sogs 'dra/ lha so so'i ngo shes shing /

mngon rtogs blo la yod na so so'i sa bon phyag mtshan las rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed bya zhing zhal bskur mi dgos/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi skabs 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang / pheṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes sbyar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: yang yang brjod pa'i rjes su/ mkhyud rgya dang yo ga shuddha'i sngags gsum/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang sangs rgyas byang sems bstim pa gnyis ka la 'dra/ rgyas btab kyi skabs su lha thams cad kyi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du zhes sogs nas/yab gnyis su med par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyi yab yum gyi go cha bkod/ dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar pheṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod dang yid mchod bdag mdun gyi dbang lha spyan 'dren skabs ltar byas la/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso/ /de bzhin 'di la deng bdag stsol cig /ces pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ las bum gyi chu dang swa bhā was rten rnams sbyangs/ rten dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ zhes pa nas/ chur gyur gyi bar bdag 'jug bzhin/ dbang lha gong du spyan drangs tshar bas 'dir mi 'dren pa/ khyed rnams kyi zhes sogs gsol btab nas/ spyan drangs te bar bdag 'jug bzhin la/ rten rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ bsam pa'i zhes tshig bsgyur nas/ nai wi dyaṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ rtogs bskyed mi dgos/ de bzhin du rin 'byung nas rnam snang ming dbang gi bar dang / brtul zhugs gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre shes par byas nas/ dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis bar/ 'on kyang gsol btab rnams kyi skabs su/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes dang / rnam snang ming dbang la/ rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes dang / brtul zhugs gnyis kyi nang dbang gi dod kyi skabs thugs kar yang bskyed pa dang 'dra ba'i zhes tshig bsgyur dang / brtul zhugs dang po'i/ deng phyin chad sogs mi dgos/ slob dpon gyi skabs su rdo rje che dang sogs/ gsang dbang la/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs dang / 'di ni byang chub sogs/ sher dbang la/ dga' ster gnas ster sogs dang / 'di ni byang chub nas/ myang bar gyis bar/ bzhi par ye shes 'di ni sogs so/ /dbang rdzas/ bum chu/ dbu brgyan/ dpa' dar/ rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ thod pa/ kha ṭwāṃ ga tshangs sku/ gsang dbang gi bdud rtsi rnams so so'i tshig brjod pa dang bstun rten gyi drung du 'bul/ mchod pa chu gnyis la bsdu dgos pas/ dri med yid du'i tshig rkang gnyis pa/ lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di zhes pa dang / lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di zhes par bsgyur/ gzhan 'dra/ mtshan sngags la mchod sngags sbyar ba'i skabs su/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ya swāhā/ sogs su bsgyur/ zhal bsgyur gyi skabs su/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung nor lha sogs rdo rje sems dpar bskyed pa rnams 'od du zhu nas/ zhes dang / gur zhal sogs mi bskyod par bskyed pa rnams zhes dang chos po ti dang gzungs dang yig 'bru rnams 'od dpag med du bskyed pa rnams zhes sbyar/ sbyin bdag bsgo ba'i skabs su khyed rang rnams padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces sbyar/ gzhan tshang ma rab gnas don gnyis lhun grub sor bzhag yin zhing /

rje btsun sa skya pa'i lugs la rab gnas kyi rgyud 'di bla med dang / rnal 'byor rgyud thun mong ba yin pas rgyud sde de gnyis nas bshad pa'i dkyil chog rnams la rab gnas kyi rgyud sbyar nas khyad chos rnams lde kha bsgyur ba'i phyag len mdzad pa bzhin sbyar la/ bde mchog gi rgyud nas bshad pa'i rab gnas ni ma yin no// //zhes pa'ang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rab gnas 'bring po'i cho ga 'khor lo bde mchog la sbyar ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
